title: AntGardern - v0.2 New Gameplay - Made with Opus 5.5
author: Old-Wolverine-4134
selftext:
New levels, new enemies, improved visuals. All is made in Unity with Opus 5.5 + Meshy for some models + ChatGPT for textures. (Some music from Suno also).

All done in the span of 1 week claude usage ($100 sub). I am currently at 90% at end of the week.

No one shot prompts - everything is done with hundreds of prompts. I keep improving on it.

comments.author: thj81
comments.body: My son love the Chrysalis books from RinoZ. He would love to play this game as he has not yet found a true and themed game that is on this level. What are you plans with it? Open source? Publicly available? Thank you.

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: Don't know yet. I am just testing out how far can I go with it. If people like it I probably will keep polishing it and may be someday will release it.
